definitions.explanation: The division within a company or organization responsible for managing finances, bookkeeping, and accounting.

examples.japanese: {経理課|けいりか}に{書類|しょるい}を{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To submit documents to the accounting department.

examples.japanese: {経理課|けいりか}で{経費|けいひ}の{精算|せいさん}をしてもらった。
examples.english: I had my expenses reimbursed by the accounting department.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}から{経理課|けいりか}に{異動|いどう}することになった。
examples.english: I have been transferred to the accounting department starting next month.

notes:
A compound of {経理|けいり} (accounting, financial management) + {課|か} (section, department). In Japanese companies, {課|か} is a standard organizational unit below {部|ぶ} (division). The {経理課|けいりか} handles daily bookkeeping, expense processing, payroll, and financial reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経理課|けいりか}に{提出|ていしゅつ}する: to submit to the accounting department
- {経理課|けいりか}の{担当者|たんとうしゃ}: person in charge in the accounting department
- {経理課|けいりか}{長|ちょう}: head of the accounting section

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {経理部|けいりぶ}: accounting division — a larger organizational unit than {経理課|けいりか}
- {総務課|そうむか}: general affairs department — handles administrative matters rather than finances
- {人事課|じんじか}: human resources department
